21.4.7? Advantages and Limitations

For most types of ground, field permeability tests yield more reliable
data than those carried out in the /aboratory, because a larger volume of
material is tested, and because the ground is tested insitu, thereby avoiding
the disturbance associated with sampling. The appropriate chorce of drilling
method and careful drilling technique are necessary to avoid disturbing the
ground to be tested. in granular soils, the ground may be loosened below the
bottom of the borehole; in layered deposits of varying permeability, a skin of
remoulded mixed material may be formed on the walls of the borehole, thus
blocking the more permeable layers, In Jointed rock, the Joints may be blocked
by the drilling debris.
